jurisdiction.venue: Southwark Crown Court & UK Serious Fraud Office (SFO)

headline: From a Spare Bedroom in Surrey, a One-Man Supply Chain Grounded the World’s Jetliners
deck: Jose Alejandro Zamora Yrala got 56 months in prison for forging airworthiness forms on 60,000 jet engine parts worth £39.3 million.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: 56 months prison in Southwark Crown Court for forging paperwork on 60,000+ jet-engine parts worth £39.3M (~$50M).
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Selling £1,400 ($1,800) in counterfeit car brake pads from a market stall
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: 18–24 months custody, without grounding commercial airliners across multiple continents

sources.title: AOG Technics Director Sentenced to Four Years and Eight Months After SFO Prosecution

interactive_art_spec.caption: A commercial CFM56 turbofan engine. AOG Technics supplied over 60,000 parts backed by forged Form 1 airworthiness certificates.
